name: 30494-shortprompt-235b-8gpu
hardware: 8x H100 80GB HBM3 -- one whole a3 node (--gres=gpu:8). Implied by `-tp 8`; nothing further about the machine is declared.
parallelism: TP=8, EP=8, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine, eager mode. Expert parallelism rides on the tensor-parallel group, so each rank owns 16 of the 128 experts of every layer. No router, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
architecture: Qwen3VLMoeForConditionalGeneration, a sparse-MoE vision-language decoder: 94 text layers, 128 routed experts with 8 active per token, block-quantised FP8, ~238 GB over 24 shards (~30 GB per GPU at TP=8). The workload is text-only, so the vision tower is never entered; the rest is in the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=256, warmup 25%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 1024 requests with a 900 s safety cap, seed 30494. Four 256-request waves, the first of them warmup; the cooldown is declared but inert at this bound.
workload: synthetic `synthetic_text`, single turn, 4 prompt tokens in and exactly 128 tokens out per request, min == max on both. Sent as plain text with no chat template, so the engine's own count is the declared 4 and a 256-request wave is ~1024 prompt tokens.
purpose: A reasoning assistant on a 235-billion-parameter model, answering 256 concurrent terse prompts with short replies across eight GPUs.
launch:
# The declared serve command for this setup, reproduced on our hardware:
#   vllm serve $MODEL -tp 8 --port 9256 --enable-expert-parallel --enforce_eager
model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 8
enable-expert-parallel: true
enforce-eager: true
dtype: bfloat16

# The declared serve command leaves these two to the engine, and `vllm serve` on an 80 GB
# non-A100 card resolves them to 1024 / 8192. This item is driven in-process instead, where the
# same two keys resolve to 128 / 2048 and the declared 256-stream burst would be admitted
# 128 at a time and its prompt chunked. Written down so the operating point is the declared one
# on either path.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
